benefit.name: Leduc Transit & Recreation Subsidies
benefit.amount: Half-price monthly bus pass of your choice (local, commuter or LATS)
benefit.summary: Financial-navigation support that can provide a half-price monthly bus pass. You choose a local, commuter or LATS pass. The Recreation Assistance Program is now closed. It will reopen for new applications in January 2027.
benefit.note: Leduc lists half-price monthly bus passes. You can choose a local, commuter or LATS monthly pass. All Recreation Assistance Program funding for 2026 has been fully allocated. The program is now closed and will reopen for new applications in January 2027.

detail.about: Leduc Family and Community Support Services can help qualifying residents access a half-price monthly bus pass as part of its housing and financial-navigation support. The Recreation Assistance Program is now closed and will reopen for new applications in January 2027.
steps: Contact Leduc FCSS for a financial-navigation appointment.
Ask about the transit subsidy when discussing your situation. Ask when the Recreation Assistance Program reopens.
Follow their directions for the documents needed to assess eligibility.
tips: You choose a local, commuter or LATS monthly pass. Ask specifically about LATS if you use specialized transit.
The City’s page describes an assessment. Do not assume you are eligible until FCSS confirms it.
detail.time: Ask FCSS when you contact them.

values.note: half-price monthly bus pass of your choice (local, commuter or LATS); recreation program now closed, reopening for new applications in January 2027
